facts.fact: The page's planning checklist image is described as a four-step infographic planning checklist.
facts.quote: A four-step infographic planning checklist for creating effective visual content with goal setting and research.

facts.fact: The page names Canva, Venngage, and Piktochart as tools that removed much of the technical setup that used to slow non-designers down.
facts.quote: Canva, Venngage, and Piktochart removed a lot of the technical setup that used to slow non-designers down.

facts.fact: The page states that a dedicated designer still makes sense for large brand campaigns, custom illustration, and strict visual systems.
facts.quote: A dedicated designer still makes sense for large brand campaigns, custom illustration, and strict visual systems.

facts.fact: The global market for infographic creation software was $1.2 billion in 2019, according to the figures cited on the Adwave page.
facts.quote: The global market for infographic creation software grew from $1.2 billion in 2019 to $3.8 billion in 2024

facts.fact: By 2023, 89% of infographic templates were downloaded by non-designers, according to the Adwave page.
facts.quote: by 2023, 89% of infographic templates were downloaded by non-designers

facts.fact: The Adwave page recommends using at most two fonts in an infographic, one for headings and one for body text.
The Adwave page recommends keeping one accent color in an infographic.
The Adwave page states that one next step, or one call to action, is enough for a single infographic.
facts.quote: One next step is enough for a single infographic.

facts.fact: The attribution line for an infographic should be visible, and citations can sit in a footer, final panel, or page note as long as readers can find them easily.
facts.quote: The attribution line is visible Long graphics can place citations in a footer, final panel, or page note, as long as readers can find them easily.

facts.fact: Assets inside a design tool library may still have limits on paid promotion, resale, broadcast use, or client transfer, so commercial rights should be documented before launch.
facts.quote: Commercial rights are documented Assets inside a design tool library may still have limits on paid promotion, resale, broadcast use, or client transfer.

facts.fact: The final infographic package should be archived in one folder containing the export, editable source file, source log, and approval notes.
facts.quote: Save the export, editable source file, source log, and approval notes in one folder.

facts.fact: After export, the CTA, URL, QR code, and landing page should each be tested on both desktop and mobile.
facts.quote: Test the CTA, URL, QR code, and landing page on desktop and mobile after export.

facts.fact: Repurposing uses such as social slices, sales one-pagers, motion graphics, or broadcast creative should have rights confirmed before production rather than later.
facts.quote: confirm those uses now instead of revisiting rights later.

facts.fact: A visual licensed for a blog post may not be the right asset for a paid ad, a client presentation, or a TV spot.
facts.quote: A visual licensed for a blog post may not be the right asset for a paid ad, a client presentation, or a TV spot.
